notes: New: Try the demo on the sign-in screen: a look around with sample tasks, notes and money. It's wiped when you leave, and never touches your account; Finance: categories you can search, add, rename, recolour, hide and delete; part paid bills; spending by category in six kinds of chart; Finance: loans with their interest rate show when they'll be cleared and what the interest costs; goals work out how much to put in each month; Friends: add each other by username and see a points leaderboard. Only points and levels are shared, never money or notes; Search on phones: a Search button in every header opens it full screen, with recent searches and results grouped by app. Improved: A calmer look: fewer colours, quieter screens, and one clear next step on empty pages. Your accounts start empty; Notes: short automatic titles (marked â€¦) until you type your own, clearer templates, and a quieter toolbar; Dates: type them, or jump to a year in two taps. The calendar keeps the same size every month; Back always works: Escape closes one thing at a time, and the Android Back button closes what's open before leaving a page. Fixed: Saving notes, backups and lists now works in the PC and Android apps too, and says where the file went; Some labels and calendar days were too faint to read easily in a few themes; A Hub backup file no longer carries the sign-in details of the accounts on that device
